label: Tesla Auto-Start Charging
info: Start policy is in the Start rules function. Plug state comes from the Victron EV charger /Status (no Tesla cache). Starts as often as needed while plugged in, at most once per 30 min; a failed start pauses 30 min (car said unplugged) or 3 h (other errors). The start command wakes the car first. Requires /data/tesla/node-red-tesla.py.

name: Notify only on successful start
func: if (String(msg.payload).trim() !== "Auto-start command succeeded at 5 A") return null; return msg;

name: Start rules: >50% OR >=20% + >700W
